comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Found with R11 or higher Search skill at landmarks in the Himalayan Region, which is accessed by going further inland via the Bay of Bengal North Coast landing point. As is customary for newer inland regions, anyone can access this area regardless of their discoveries/port permit status. Stats:

Collection +1
5k fame to equip, unisex

Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.
